_meta.usage: 1994–2016 private plates (flag in a narrow band at the left, then a region letter, four digits and one or two letters: B 1234 AB): type the whole plate or only the first letter
_meta.note: The first letter is the region of registration at the time. Company plates of the same years (1234 BA, four digits first) also start their letters with the region letter: look up that letter alone. Issue of this format stopped in July 2025, so these plates are on older cars that have not been re-registered.
_meta.miss_note: not a 1994–2016 Kyrgyz private plate: a current plate (two-digit code first; use `--kind plate`), a personalised plate, a diplomatic plate, or a plate of another country
